mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.user.selectUser */ USER_ID as userId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, NAME as name, EMAIL as email, PASSWORD as password, ROLE as role, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.user.selectUser */ u.USER_ID as userId, u.TENANT_ID as tenantId, u.NAME as name, u.EMAIL as email, u.PASSWORD as password, u.ROLE as role, u.CREATED_AT as createdAt, t.is_active as isActive -- tenant 테이블에서 is_active를 가져옴 FROM USER u INNER JOIN tenant t -- tenant 테이블과 USER 테이블을 tenant_id를 기준으로 조인 ON u.TENANT_ID = t.tenant_id WHERE u.EMAIL = #{email} and u.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.user.selectListUser */ USER_ID as userId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, NAME as name, EMAIL as email, PASSWORD as password, ROLE as role, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM USER WHERE 1=1
AND TENANT_ID like '%${scTenantId}%'
AND NAME like '%${scName}%'
AND EMAIL like '%${scEmail}%'
AND ROLE like '%${scRole}%'
AND CREATED_AT like '%${scCreatedAt}%'
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.user.selectListCountUser */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM USER WHERE 1=1
AND TENANT_ID like '%${scTenantId}%'
AND NAME like '%${scName}%'
AND EMAIL like '%${scEmail}%'
AND ROLE like '%${scRole}%'
AND CREATED_AT like '%${scCreatedAt}%'

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.name AS name, u.email AS email, u.role AS role, u.created_at AS createdAt, t.is_active AS isActive FROM USER u LEFT JOIN tenant t ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE u.email = #{email} ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
